title: WASD Tweaks
description: This tweaks helpful for novices in Minecraft, includes Edge Guard, Lava Guard, AutoSprint, AutoTool, SmartLadder, AttackLock. Not recomended to play on public servers. Play only if servers allows tweaks like this. QoL mod and also my first mod.
body:
# WASD TWEAKS
This mod was created by Ninyl_. It is mainly intended for Minecraft beginners, but it can also be useful for regular players. 

Some features of this mod may conflict with the rules of certain public Minecraft servers. Before using it freely on a server, make sure that tweaks like these are allowed by the server rules or by the administration.

**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This is my first mod, by the way. So if you find any bugs, feel free to send me a direct message on Discord you can find me by the tag @ninyl.

</details>

**

**Thank you for visiting this mod’s page. I will also try to adapt the mod for newer Minecraft versions.**

### Best regards,
### Ninyl
